	prototype_time = sp_time.prototype.medium

	narrative = {
		name = zin_sp_lifting_the_curse
		desc = zin_sp_lifting_the_curse_desc
	}
	project_output = {
		facility_state_effects = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_inst_scar_hollow }
				}
				remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_inst_scar_hollow }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_inst_scar_wrecked }
				}
				remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_inst_scar_wrecked }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_inst_scar_scorched }
				}
				remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_inst_scar_scorched }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_inst_scar_blighted }
				}
				remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_inst_scar_blighted }
			}
			every_neighbor_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_inst_scar_hollow }
					}
					remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_inst_scar_hollow }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_inst_scar_wrecked }
					}
					remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_inst_scar_wrecked }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_inst_scar_scorched }
					}
					remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_inst_scar_scorched }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_inst_scar_blighted }
					}
					remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_inst_scar_blighted }
				}
			}
		}
		country_effects = {
			every_scientist = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_sch_marked }
					}
					remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_sch_marked }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	generic_prototype_rewards = {
		zin_sp_reward_steady_small_deep

		zin_sp_reward_steady_large_deep
